question: Captain Pratima Bhullar Maldonado, an Indian-origin police officer, has become the highest-ranking South Asian woman in the ______ Police Department in May, 2023.
solution:
The correct answer is __**New York**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Captain Pratima Bhullar Maldonado**, an Indian-origin police officer, has become the highest-ranking South Asian woman in the **New York Police Department** in May 2023.
 
• Her promotion marks a significant milestone for representation of South Asian women in law enforcement in the United States.
 
• Captain Maldonado has had a distinguished career with the NYPD, demonstrating exceptional leadership and dedication to community service.
 
• Her achievement is celebrated as a source of inspiration for many aspiring law enforcement officers from diverse backgrounds.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **New York Police Department (NYPD)** is one of the oldest and largest municipal police departments in the **United States**, established in **1845**.
 
• The NYPD is responsible for **law enforcement and crime prevention** in New York City, serving over 8 million residents.
 
• It is known for its comprehensive approach to policing, including community policing initiatives, counter-terrorism efforts, and advanced technological integration in law enforcement.
 
• The NYPD has a diverse workforce with officers from various ethnic, racial, and cultural backgrounds, reflecting the city's multicultural population.
 
• Promotions within the NYPD are based on merit, experience, and demonstrated leadership abilities.
